source.title: Dragonflight 2022 beta milling original-summary cross-check; cross-site search for unindexed random-processing samples

notes: New search angle: non-English indexed item comments, independently ranked ore identity pages and historical mining-vs-prospecting source distinction. Genuine name-first source searches did not yield a NEW source-original completed-cast per-material zero-inclusive histogram for Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting or Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage/Hochenblume milling. The three firsthand Mystic disenchant single-operation outcomes surfaced via search already exist in earlier v3 records; preserving source lineage prevents duplicate cohorts. Known ore IDs independently checked: Draconium 189143 R1/188658 R2/190311 R3; Serevite 190395 R1/190396 R2/190394 R3; Khaz'gorite 190312 R1/190313 R2/190314 R3. Identity checks are not new measured processing cohorts. 2-5 mill yields are historical beta/reference only; no measured modern histogram. No invented casts, hits, zeros, probability or prices.
